question: What is the DIMMS Lab that Woldegebriel Assefa Woldegerima directs at York University?
answer: he is the founding director of the Disease-Informed Modelling, Methods & Systems Lab (DIMMS Lab) and also serves as Associate Director of the Laboratory for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (LIAM).
